#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

int compute_gcd(int a, int b) {
    return b == 0 ? a : compute_gcd(b, a % b);
}

int main() {
    int x, y, limit;
    cin >> x >> y >> limit;
    double min_diff = 1e9;
    int ans_num, ans_den;
    double ratio = (double)x / y;

    for (int i = 1; i <= limit; ++i) {
        int b = (long long)x * i / y;
        double a = (double)b / i;
        double a_minus = (double)(abs(b - 1)) / i;
        double a_plus = (double)(b + 1) / i;

        if (fabs(ratio - a) < min_diff) {
            ans_num = b;
            ans_den = i;
            min_diff = fabs(ratio - a);
        }
        if (fabs(ratio - a_minus) < min_diff) {
            ans_num = abs(b - 1);
            ans_den = i;
            min_diff = fabs(ratio - a_minus);
        }
        if (fabs(ratio - a_plus) < min_diff) {
            ans_num = b + 1;
            ans_den = i;
            min_diff = fabs(ratio - a_plus);
        }
    }

    if (fabs(1.0 - ratio) <= (fabs((double)ans_num / ans_den) - ratio) + 1e-9) {
        ans_num = 1;
        ans_den = 1;
    }

    int g = compute_gcd(ans_num, ans_den);
    cout << ans_num / g << "/" << ans_den / g << endl;
    return 0;
}
